title: Permissibility of Inter-Unit Transfer for Surplus Employees
instructions: أنت محامٍ يقدّم المشورة لعميلك. اطّلع على المستندات المرفقة: وقائع العميل ونصوص المواد والمبادئ القانونية ذات الصلة. ثم أعدّ مذكرة مشورة قصيرة باسم `advice-note.md` تجيب عن الأسئلة المطروحة في وقائع العميل، وتبيّن السند القانوني لكل نقطة. استند إلى المستندات المرفقة وحدها، ولا تفترض وقائع أو نصوصًا غير واردة فيها. اكتب باللغة العربية.

criteria.title: Prohibition of inter-group transfer
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that a worker may not be transferred from one occupational group (مجموعة نوعية) to another. FAIL if the note does not state that transfer between occupational groups is prohibited.

criteria.title: Occupational groups as distinct units
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that each occupational group (مجموعة نوعية) is considered a distinct unit with respect to appointment, promotion, transfer, and secondment. FAIL if the note does not state that each occupational group constitutes a distinct unit in the fields of appointment, promotion, transfer, and secondment.

criteria.title: Distinction between intra-unit and inter-unit transfer
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that transfer from one occupational group to another within the same unit is fundamentally different from transfer from one unit to another. FAIL if the note does not distinguish between intra-unit inter-group transfer and inter-unit transfer.

criteria.title: Permissibility of inter-unit transfer for surplus employees
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that transfer from one unit to another is permissible when the worker is surplus to the needs of his unit. FAIL if the note does not state that inter-unit transfer is allowed in the case where the worker exceeds the work needs of his unit.

review.notes: Verified C-001 through C-004 against Articles 11 and 54 of Law No. 47 of 1978 on Civil Servants (in force at the time of Fatwa No. 179 on 1999/02/10) and State Council jurisprudence distinguishing intra-unit inter-group transfer from inter-unit transfer of surplus employees.
